chapter: Chicago, the Marable boats and Marge's St. Louis family band
title: The Jeffrey Tavern band and singer Ellen Savage
summary: Zutty describes the band at Jeffrey Tavern: three saxes, four rhythm, two trumpets and a trombone, playing a show with the shouting singer Ellen Savage.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you go there after Roulette, after the Roulette band. Or you went and got with Doc Cook.
No. Let him just finish that Roulette thing. You were saying that he was a saxophone player.
And the band was how many sax's?
Well, including -- well, not including him, see.
And we had four rhythm, and trumpets. We had two trumpets, trombone, and that was it.
And at this place, Jeffrey's Tavern, you have to play a show?
Had to play a show, and they had a girl by the name of Ellen Savage, really used to shout them, you know.
Yes, I've got records of hers.
Yes. That child could really sing.
